title: Lead time runs on *four* clocks
subtitle: System plans on 14 days. Reality is 21. Illustrative numbers.

stages.name: PO approval
stages.desc: Request to released PO. The clock most teams forget.

stages.name: Supplier
stages.desc: Released PO to goods dispatched. The quote in your system.

stages.name: Transit
stages.desc: Dispatch to your gate, including customs and queues.

stages.name: Dock-to-stock
stages.desc: Unloaded to pickable. Inspection, put-away, posting.

takeaway: Lead time = approval + supplier + transit + dock-to-stock. Illustrative: 21 days, not 14.

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
